business_problem: When cynapse.ai was founded, its solutions needed to be deployed on-premises, but as customers, including large enterprises and government agencies, began requesting more flexible cloud-based options, the team had a vision to make that a reality.
solution_summary: cynapse.ai cynapse.ai powers cloud-based solutions and future-proofs its agentic video AI research with Compute Engine. When cynapse.ai was founded, its solutions needed to be deployed on-premises, but as customers, including large enterprises and government agencies, began requesting more flexible cloud-based options, the team had a vision to make that a reality. Making the change required finding centralized GPU resources to avoid fragmenting compute across multiple regions. “GPU Hardware availability made it challenging to stand up cloud-based services in a few regions, so we needed an alternative that offered scalable, flexible deployments and would work well with our existing infrastructure. Having the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform included was a strong added benefit,” shares Illy Gruber, CMO and Product Head at cynapse.ai.

solution_components.name: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
solution_components.role: Coordinates multi-agent workflows, tool calling, and governed automation across the application.

solution_components.name: Compute Engine
solution_components.role: Runs serverless or virtualized application services with elastic scale for production AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Cloud Storage
solution_components.role: Stores large files, lake data, or static assets that feed downstream analytics and applications.

solution_components.name: Cloud Load Balancing
solution_components.role: Routes highly variable enterprise campaign traffic into the ML platform.
